title: Orchard and Promise
author: Jude Amberdale
blurb: Beatrix Crane, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
